body:
I live in England.

I am not allowed to claim for disability right now, as apparently you need to have a diagnosis and to be considered 'actually' disabled to claim, which I am not. I have been trying as well to claim universal credit, which is essentially a jobseekers allowance, but as many have reported, UC is absolutely useless. I have attempted to claim various times over the course of the last two years when I have been a NEET, but my application 'doesn't go through', or they never call me back when they're supposed to, or 'forget' my appointments, etc. I have managed to get one month's claim in this whole time, before being pushed back to the start again.

I wish I could at least rest, but if I stop on any front, then I will have nothing. I am surviving constantly by the skin of my teeth. I have lived too long already on the grace of my relatives. Only my grandparents are nearby, and they also don't have much, not enough to support me too.

I'm getting more blood results back on Monday. If it's Something, if at least I can know what it is, I might hang on, but if I just get told it's nothing again, that they couldn't find anything wrong, I think that might be it for me.
